Lina: Quick sync  Were doing a targeted priming run for HelioCorp's dedicated pool tomorrow 07:00 PDT. Objectives: confirm quota math, validate autoscale transition behavior, run an extended 25m steady soak to watch tail latencies and 429s.
Ravi: I can take infra. What instance class and initial slots?
Lina: n-infer-a100-80gb, starting at 10 slots (they purchased 8). Want a small buffer for bursts. SLO: p95 < 150ms for 64-token completions.
Paul: From CS: we'll coordinate with Helio ops to flip traffic. Also want a quick SDK smoke on their side to ensure retries are configured.
Sophie: Ill handle the customer-facing checklist and capture any enablement gaps. Can we add a one-click rollback plan?
Ravi: Autoscaler profile = "gradual-hold-v1" (min 6, desired 10, max 14). I'll set the quota window to 1.4x steady qps for the test. If scaling stalls >2m, alert paging.
Lina: Test steps: 1) 3m light smoke at 30% qps, 2) linear ramp to 100% over 12m, 3) 25m steady state with random 2x bursts, 4) 5m blast to 4x then cool-down. Metrics: per-route p50/p95/p99, 429 rate, 5xx count, KV cache hit ratio, and token-cost delta.
Paul: We'll also run 50 inference samples against their critical prompt set during the soak to detect any quality drift. I'll paste prompts in the doc.
Sophie: Minimal preflight for Helio ops: (a) API key with dedicated scope, (b) route pinned to pool ID, (c) SDK >= 2.5 with backoff enabled, (d) contact for immediate cutoff, (e) KMS test decrypt. I'll put this in the invite.
build-bot: Provisioning event: pool-helio-prime-82 requested by ravi at 1887654360  provisioning started.
Ravi: Nodes are provisioning, a couple of drivers need a reboot but should be green in ~4m.
Lina: If we hit >0.5% 5xx during steady-state we abort and failover to shared. Also capture traces for any request >500ms.
Paul: Noted. I'll enable distributed tracing and keep an eye on tail latencies.
Sophie: Scheduling a 06:30 PDT prep call with Helio ops to walk the checklist and notify their on-call. Invite sent.
Paul: Side note for renewal: capture any config items Helio asks for during the soak. We want to close those before QBR.
Lina: Good call. After the run we'll post a short ops summary + per-route dashboard and a one-paragraph exec note for renewals.
Ravi: Load generator command (local):
Ravi: ```k6 run --vus 60 --duration 25m --out json=results.json loadscript.js```
Sophie: Perfect. See you all on the prep call.
Lina: Thanks team  keep the rollback channel open.
